desc:
🚀 Build Your Own Gas Station! ⛽[BETA]
⭐ Private Servers Are Free - Use Them For Best Game Experience and no lag ⭐

Create your dream gas station on Roblox!
Hire workers, upgrade your station and earn big! 
PC recommended for best experience, but mobile users supported too!

🎉 UPDATE 17 IS LIVE! 

What is happened in this update?
- 2 New Pumps! (Hive Pump and Desert Pump)
- 3 New Tanks! (Hive Tank, Bone Tank, Fish Tank)
- New mutations added! (Hacked, Error, Fire)
- Reworked CustomerDisplayer (it now shows the buffs it gives passively!)
- THE SNOW IS GONE! (its still a bit chilly though!)

We are working hard again in the back doing our best to try put up with the updates.


📅 More updates to release during the upcoming weeks—going into Christmas and New Years.

🇨 🇴 🇩 🇪 🇸
- Find current game codes in socials!
